scope: Four Home discovery shortcut images only

prompts.prayer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small original 3D object icon for an Islamic mobile app Home shortcut card, belonging to the same clean emoji-like set as a simple prayer-bead strand and a Kaaba with small compass. Clear compact silhouette, plausible simple geometry, matte tactile material, softly rounded crisp edges. Restrained handcrafted look rather than ornate AI diorama. Soft broad studio light from upper left, slight grounding shadow only. Mild three-quarter front view, centered square composition, entire subject visible, 12% transparent padding. Use natural saturated but tasteful colors; do not restrict the object to green and gold. Truly transparent background. No background tile, scene, scenery, glow, sparkles, excessive ornaments, pseudo-Arabic, watermark or branding. Subject: one partially unfurled cobalt-blue prayer mat with a rolled far end, warm ivory edge trim and a simple ivory arch-shaped woven mihrab outline, subtle rust-orange tassels. The folded/rolled fabric is tactile, its outline clear and recognizable. No person, floor or extra objects. No writing, numbers or sacred text. This symbolizes learning to pray, not a diagram of correct prayer posture.
